title: Fused silica microspheres from fulgurites; Drumm inside a boat pit
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Fused silica microspheres from fulgurites; Drumm inside a boat pit, about recent at Egypt (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: fused silica this is me down inside one of the boat pits adjacent to the great pyramid

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a man with his own theory about the true purpose of the pyramids, showed podcast host Jesse Michels a picture of himself down inside one of the boat pits, the stone pits beside the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt where ancient boats were buried. He talks about finding fused silica there, tiny glassy beads like those in fulgurites, the glass tubes that form when lightning hits sand. To him, this would mean powerful electrical activity once happened at the site.
